propositions: review-bot container has no AWS region configured (AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION unset), causing boto3 to raise NoRegionError at Bedrock client construction, which is not caught as rebar's LLMError and fails the review gate with no fallback provider
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, falling through to boto3's ambient resolution which returns None in the container environment

boto3 region resolution in this botocore version honors AWS_DEFAULT_REGION but not AWS_REGION, and IMDS reachability does not supply a region, so the configuration must be explicit and independent of IMDS contingency

pydantic-ai raises a UserError (not LLMConfigError) when region is missing, causing the review bot's fail-closed handler to not intercept it and leaving an actionable error message naming only pydantic-ai's kwarg (region_name) rather than rebar's setting (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION)

the existing Bedrock verification probes all passed region explicitly, masking the ambient resolution defect, and the cutover runbook encoded this blind spot by not exercising region discovery without an explicit override
CloudWatch voter metrics in review-bot silently no-op for the same missing-region reason, breaking the eb6e rollback plan which depends on VOTER_ERROR alarms firing
